notes.title: The Underking Dog Updated to Version 0.0.5
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Community we have just released our v0.0.5 for The Underdog King. [/h1]
1. Reduce the Boss Zuoyao Mai fight difficulty. 
2. Fixed an issue when player received an item and attributes but don't have time to read.
3. Fixed an issue during the Boss fight player always miss the target.
4. Increased the size of counter attack button.
5. Fixed an issue the speed of plot texts too fast.
6. Fixed an issue make the speed of Auto-play more friendly to player.
7. Performance and stability improvements for Players.
